lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The flank displays multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximate vertical columns. A central row of three large, distinct blobs is visible posterior to the gill region, following a linear posterior-ventral trajectory.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of spots, creating a grid-like pattern where high-luminance blobs are localized within the lighter vertical corridors.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and high-contrast shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is visible swimming in the water column between the pectoral fin and the gill slits.
